# Spain Declared Crops (Cultivos Declarados SIGPAC)

Spain field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Fondo Español de Garantía Agraria (FEGA). License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es/latest/es.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4258; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: collection, irrigation_system, hcat:code, id, crop:code, geometry, hcat:name_en, hcat:name, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es/collection.json
